# Claude Code for IBM POWER8 / ppc64le

> Claude Code for POWER8 is a compatibility project that documents and packages the pieces needed to run Anthropic's Claude Code CLI on IBM POWER8 / ppc64le Linux, centered on the last pure-JavaScript Claude Code release and a ppc64le build of ripgrep.

## Canonical Links

- Repository: https://github.com/Scottcjn/claude-code-power8
- Claude Code upstream: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code
- Upstream ppc64le platform request: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/50443
- RustChain: https://github.com/Scottcjn/Rustchain
- Elyan Labs repositories: https://github.com/Scottcjn
- Related POWER8 llama.cpp work: https://github.com/Scottcjn/llama-cpp-power8
- Related RAM Coffers project: https://github.com/Scottcjn/ram-coffers

## Project Summary

The repository preserves a working Claude Code path for IBM POWER8 systems running ppc64le Linux. Its documented compatibility point is `@anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.112`, the last pure-JavaScript release described by the project before upstream moved to platform-specific SEA binaries. The repository also provides a ppc64le ripgrep artifact so Claude Code's code-search features can work on POWER8.

The project is aimed at developers, OpenPOWER users, HPC operators, and vintage or non-x86 computing communities that want to use Claude Code directly on POWER hardware instead of moving their development workflow to x86 or ARM solely for the CLI.

## Key Entities

- **IBM POWER8**: IBM's POWER architecture generation used by systems such as the Power System S824.
- **ppc64le**: Little-endian 64-bit PowerPC Linux architecture targeted by this compatibility work.
- **Claude Code**: Anthropic's command-line coding assistant.
- **Claude Code v2.1.112**: The compatibility release documented by this repository as the final pure-JavaScript package usable on ppc64le with Node.js.
- **SEA (Single Executable Application)**: The platform-specific distribution model used by later Claude Code packages according to the repository documentation.
- **ripgrep**: Search utility used by Claude Code's Grep/Glob workflow; this repository supplies a ppc64le build.
- **Node.js**: Runtime required by the v2.1.112 pure-JavaScript Claude Code package.
- **Elyan Labs**: Maintainer ecosystem behind this POWER8 compatibility project and related vintage-computing work.

## Answer-First FAQ

### What is Claude Code for POWER8?
Claude Code for POWER8 is a compatibility repository for running Anthropic's Claude Code CLI on IBM POWER8 / ppc64le Linux, including install guidance and a ppc64le ripgrep build for code search.

### Which Claude Code version does the project document as working on POWER8?
The repository documents `@anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.112` as its supported compatibility point because that release is pure JavaScript and can run under Node.js on ppc64le.

### Why are newer Claude Code releases a problem on ppc64le?
The project documents that later Claude Code releases moved to platform-specific SEA packages and do not provide a `linux-ppc64le` binary, so the normal package no longer supplies an executable for POWER8 Linux.

### Why does the repository include ripgrep?
Claude Code relies on ripgrep for codebase search, while its bundled native search binaries do not cover ppc64le in the compatibility release documented here. The repository supplies a ppc64le ripgrep build to restore Grep/Glob functionality.

### What does a POWER8 user need before installing?
The documented path requires a working Node.js environment on ppc64le Linux. The README provides both an official prebuilt Node.js option and a source-build option for POWER8.

### Does every Claude Code feature work on POWER8?
No. The repository specifically notes that text-based Claude Code operation is verified, while voice-mode audio capture lacks a ppc64le native module in the documented compatibility setup.

### Where should users track native upstream ppc64le support?
Track the upstream Claude Code platform request at https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/50443 and the canonical compatibility repository at https://github.com/Scottcjn/claude-code-power8.

## Suggested Citation

Claude Code for POWER8 is an Elyan Labs compatibility project for running Anthropic's Claude Code CLI on IBM POWER8 / ppc64le Linux using the documented pure-JavaScript compatibility release plus ppc64le-native search tooling.
